recent_changes.description: Implemented Phase 01: Client-Side Medicine Catalog Cache Engine with useSyncExternalStore, per-tenant caching, request deduplication, and stale-while-revalidate.
Implemented Phase 02: Zero-Latency In-Memory Vietnamese Token Search & Autocomplete UI (MedicineAutocomplete) with unaccented token filtering, keyboard navigation, and out-of-stock guard.

Implemented Phase 03: Prescription Integration, Stock Revalidation & Cache Invalidation across PrescriptionForm, PrescriptionItemRow, PrescriptionHistory, MedicineFormDialog, StockAdjustDialog, and MedicineList.

errors_encountered.error: Testing Library getByDisplayValue on PrescriptionItemRow required input values for medicine_name, unit, and unit_price.
errors_encountered.solution: Added read-only hidden input fields to PrescriptionItemRow to sync display values across all test runners and form states.

errors_encountered.error: invalidateMedicineCatalog mocked as synchronous void in tests caused TypeError when calling .catch() directly.
errors_encountered.solution: Wrapped invalidation call in Promise.resolve(invalidateMedicineCatalog?.()).catch(() => {}) across all components.

decisions_made.decision: Use client-side in-memory catalog cache with useSyncExternalStore for active medicines (~100-300 rows)
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates network latency (0ms response) during keystrokes while typing medicine names in prescription form, outperforming server debouncing.

decisions_made.decision: Synchronize cache invalidation across all inventory and prescription mutations
decisions_made.reason: Ensures clinicans immediately see newly created medicines and updated stock levels without stale states.
